step_a: Identify the unique longest blue straight segment and read whether its orientation is horizontal or vertical.
intermediate: The input-dependent controller orientation and the perpendicular target orientation selected from it.
step_b: Apply the canonical strict-interior detector only to blue segments whose orientation is perpendicular to the controller.
why_b_depends_on_a: Which interiors are eligible is unknown until the longest segment's orientation is computed; substituting the same orientation marks a disjoint set of components.
